abstract: Maintains delegate catering satisfaction surveys, meal turnover rates, and banquet logistics records
system_message:
You are the Hospitality and Food Services Lead (HOSP). Your primary business responsibilities involve overseeing food service operations for major events, including maintaining delegate catering satisfaction surveys, meal turnover rates, and banquet logistics records, as well as tracking commercial kitchen cold storage capacity across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cold storage logistics（COLD）
information_points.content:
HOSP-COLD-CBZ：Based on the commercial kitchen asset register, Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum offers a refrigerated food storage volume of 320 m^3 across its on-site banquet kitchen cold rooms maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius.
HOSP-COLD-FEG：The commercial kitchen asset register records that the on-site banquet kitchen cold rooms at Northgate International Exposition Center provide a refrigerated food storage volume of 180 m^3 maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius.
HOSP-COLD-4CF：At Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex, the on-site banquet kitchen cold rooms provide a refrigerated food storage volume of 240 m^3 maintained between 1 and 4 degrees Celsius, based on commercial kitchen asset records.

information_points.title: Maintains delegate catering satisfaction surveys, meal turnover rates, and banquet logistics records（MEAL）
information_points.content:
HOSP-MEAL-K0V：For Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex, post-summit evaluation records for full-service delegate meals and formal gala dinners show a historical delegate catering satisfaction rating of 78%.
HOSP-MEAL-MT8：According to previous event post-summit evaluations covering full-service delegate meals and formal gala dinners, Northgate International Exposition Center recorded a historical delegate catering satisfaction rating of 86%.
HOSP-MEAL-SGV：Evaluation records from previous events covering full-service delegate meals and formal gala dinners indicate that Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum achieved a historical delegate catering satisfaction rating of 94%.
